overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a strong, academically focused cross-platform presence across LinkedIn, Bluesky, and Mastodon with a total reach of 3,580 followers. Engagement across all accounts is high, heavily driven by research announcements, software releases, and recruitment posts tailored to computational social science and disinformation studies.

contentThemes.description: Announcements regarding new papers, grant awards, and tool updates like CooRnet v2.0.
Hiring posts for postdocs and PhD research opportunities in computational social science.
Posts covering coordinated inauthentic behavior, conference presentations, and cross-platform analysis.

recommendations: Increase posting frequency on LinkedIn, as it yields the highest absolute engagement per post (likes and comments).
Cross-promote software updates like CooRnet v2.0 onto LinkedIn, where professional visibility is strongest.
Utilize Bluesky's high repost-to-like ratio by including clear calls-to-action (e.g., links to full papers or project repos).

platformInsights.bluesky: Generates the highest repost rate relative to likes, showing strong virality and community sharing for publications and academic opportunities.
platformInsights.mastodon: Fosters niche engagement around open-source tools and methodology discussions, though overall engagement counts are lower.
platformInsights.linkedin: Drives the highest volume of total engagement (likes and comments per post), serving as the main professional hub for announcements and hiring.

topPerformingContent.content: Excited to announce that our research team has been awarded a new grant to study information operations across social media platforms.
Just published our new paper on coordinated inauthentic behavior on social media platforms!
Our team has just released v2.0 of CooRnet, with improved algorithms for detecting coordinated link sharing behavior.
